description: This 3D model features a highly detailed adult Sperm Whale, created with accurate proportions, clean topology, and realistic surface detail to capture the powerful and majestic look of this deep-sea giant. The model is fully rigged and animated for smooth, natural swimming and body movement, and uses high-quality PBR textures that give the skin a believable wet, organic appearance under any modern renderer, making it perfect for cinematic ocean scenes, documentaries, and ultra-realistic marine projects 🐋
